verdict.rationale: Ledgy is an equity-management SaaS that holds sensitive customer data, so an AI-training opt-out or data-use policy is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack addresses AI model training, data-use policies, or opt-out controls. The permission-segmentation and access-control items are adjacent features and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
